text:
Nora: quick all-hands follow-up Qs about hybrid/office ops and last-minute travel/offsite changes. trying to capture notes for managers.

Diego: go for it. what came up?

Nora: 1) cancellation policy for offsites (force majeure / vendor cancellations) 1) can managers still book refundable hotel rates w/o extra sign-off? 3) are we changing the commuter stipend or hub parking rules?

Sasha: good set. cancellation: if vendor cancels <10 business days before, People Ops will triage refunds and allocate emergency budget for rebooking if the event is business-critical. if cancellation is due to weather or travel bans, we default to virtual fallback and reimburse non-refundable incurred costs on a case-by-case basis. we'll maintain a vendor risk log.

Nora: what about managers needing to cancel due to travel restrictions for multiple team members (e.g., region-wide)?

Sasha: if >30% of attendees can't travel, request a cancellation exception via People Ops; we'll either postpone or approve cost absorption based on event priority and budget. exceptions get Director review.

Diego: hotels: managers can book refundable rates up to $300/night without extra sign-off for domestic travel. above $300 or non-refundable rates require Manager + People Ops sign-off at booking. include a short justification in the booking request.

Nora: parking / commuter stipend?

Sasha: commuter stipend unchanged for now. hub parking: short-term permits available via facilities; long-term parking for assigned desk holders requires facilities approval and justification. we'll revisit parking policy in Q3 with usage numbers.

facilities-bot: Note: SF hub desk booking still 14-day rolling window; no change. Exceptions via facilities@redwood with project justification.

Diego: can we get a template email for managers to notify attendees about cancellations + reimbursement steps? saves time.

peopleops-bot: Draft cancellation template uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/ops/offsite-cancellation-template (auto). People Ops will publish guidance and an FAQ by Friday.

Nora: sweet. one more: hybrid retreat planning  can teams request a mixed in-person + remote hub day ("hub day")? any capacity rules?

Sasha: yes. "hub day" allowed. capacity: hubs operate at 60% capacity for booking to leave space for rotation. if you expect >40% attendance from a single team, coordinate with facilities to reserve dedicated space. add a note in the People Ops form.

Diego: thanks, will add to the eng managers doc and ping folks. if anything urgent DM me. :thumbsup:

Nora: closing loop. TL;DR: cancellation escalation workflow added, refundable booking guidance clarified, commuter/parking unchanged, hub capacity guidance for hub-day. will share manager-ready blurb after People Ops publishes the FAQ.
